name: Hexapod
description: Insect layout with coxa + femur + tibia legs and a tripod gait. Wide, low, always three feet down.

proposal.summary: All-terrain workhorse: wide stance, low hull, tripod gait.
decisions: 3-segment legs (coxa/femur/tibia) with knees pointing up and out.
Tripod keeps three feet down, so no Gyro Stabilizer is needed (D6).
openQuestions: Six legs × 3 segments as contraptions (D2): 18 contraption segments is the most of any example. Does that fit the server budget once calibrated?
